issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch could confuse students about the intended API and may prevent external code (or tests) from calling the method as the specification implies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of getTotalNumberOfStudents() consistent with the UML and template expectations. Change the solution method declaration from protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents() to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(), or alternately update the problem statement/UML to indicate it should be protected if that was the intended design.
